reviewer: Consolidated recorded source reviewers and cross-family source-overlap review
rationale: Row eligibility reviews plus exact source/context grouping over all candidates and recorded source/variant relation reviews. Prior and both smoke campaigns are excluded transitively. 3000 selected groups satisfy all family quotas. This is a reproducible grouping protocol, not mathematical proof of semantic independence or exhaustive factual verification.

review_scope.purpose: Usable tasks for cumulative-token measurement; not a benchmark-accuracy certification
review_scope.coding: Bounded source and supplied-test coherence; no host execution of reference code
review_scope.govreport: Sampled source usability, except documented full reads; not exhaustive full-report/reference verification
review_scope.other_families: Recorded full instruction/context/reference inspection for approved rows
review_scope.quality: Reference-based scores diagnostic only; disputed or imperfect labels documented in reviews
review_scope.complexity: unrated; natural input length is not a difficulty label
review_scope.grouping: Mandatory exact normalization plus reviewed concrete task/source relations; generic topic/operation alone is not a shared template
review_scope.limitations: Unselected source records are not all semantically reviewed; relatedness below screening thresholds may remain undetected
